    (1, 3): [], (2, 3): [], (3, 3): []
}

for risk in risks:

    if key in matrix_data:

# Col F=6, G=7, H=8
# Row 12=L3, 13=L2, 14=L1

    (1, 1): (14, 6), (2, 1): (14, 7), (3, 1): (14, 8),
    (1, 2): (13, 6), (2, 2): (13, 7), (3, 2): (13, 8),
    (1, 3): (12, 6), (2, 3): (12, 7), (3, 3): (12, 8),
}

for coords, risk_ids in matrix_data.items():
    row, col = mapping[coords]
    # Join multiple IDs with commas, or empty string if none
    cell_value = ", ".join(risk_ids) if risk_ids else ""
    ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = cell_value
